from confluent_kafka import Producer, Consumer
from kafka import KafkaConsumer, KafkaProducer

def publish_order(p: Producer):
    p.produce("order.created", value=b"v")

def publish_via_kp(p: KafkaProducer):
    p.send("inventory.updated", value=b"v")

def subscribe_orders(c: Consumer):
    c.subscribe(["order.created", "audit.events"])

def consume_user_signups():
    c = KafkaConsumer("user.signed_in", group_id="audit")
    for msg in c:
        pass
